label: SspABCD-SspE system
definition: A phosphorothioate defense system in which an organism possesses an SspABCD-SspE locus that pairs an SspABCD single-stranded DNA phosphorothioation module with the SspE restriction enzyme to sense host phosphorothioate marks and nick invading DNA.
observations: SspABCD-SspE branch under phosphorothioate defense system; distinct from individual ssp genes, the SspABCD modification module by itself, the SspE restriction enzyme by itself, SspFGH systems, Dnd systems, archaeal phosphorothioate antiviral systems, source database rows naming one predicted PT locus, phosphorothioate modification as a chemical trait, and the broader phosphorothioate defense parent.
